description: Checkmyguest offers you this exceptional 60m² apartment, nestled in the heart of Paris' vibrant Pigalle-Sopi district. Ideally located near the Folies Bergère, a landmark of Parisian nightlife, this apartment offers a dynamic yet authentic living environment.The spaceThis 6-person apartment is much more than just a place to live. It's an opportunity to live in the heart of Paris's effervescence, while enjoying modern comforts, elegant decor and undeniable charm in the effervescent Pigalle-Sopi district. From the moment you enter, you'll be seduced by the elegance and comfort of this space. You'll find : - A cosy living room with a sofa bed and a second sofa for relaxing moments.- A fully equipped open kitchen, including fridge, induction hob, microwave, kettle, toaster and large dining table for convivial meals.- A first welcoming bedroom with a double bed, carefully furnished to create a sanctuary of comfort and relaxation. - A second bedroom with bunk beds for a practical sleeping experience.- Two bathrooms, each equipped with a modern shower, offering optimum comfort.- A separate toilet for added convenience. - Numerous optimized stord Internet (WIFI)- Bed linen and towels areage spaces to organize your belongings.- Television and high-spee provided by us.Guest accessYou will have access to the entire apartment, so you will feel at home.Other things to noteThis booking is protected with coverage for lost luggage and emergency medical expenses, provided by Travel Support with claim upto 750 Euros (T&C Applies). Full details are available at the time of booking.
